title: You Think Mental Images Jump Instantly, Yet Your Brain Turns Shapes Degree by Degree
description:
You think mental pictures jump into place right away! Yet your mind turns shapes at a fixed speed! This is the true story of Roger Shepard's rotation experiment. Here is what went wrong with strict behaviorist rules.
